item.title: [−1] Brent rebounds 3.88% to $98.29 on new tanker attacks after Wednesday's 8.7% plunge
item.description:

item.title: [−1] Iran says two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz; four attacks logged in 96 hours
item.description:
One blaze was tied to a mine. Iran keeps exemptions for Indian, Chinese, Iraqi and Qatari ships while the US blockade continues. Attacks persisting.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Insurance risk

Why it matters: Continuing attacks keep insurance and freight costs high even as Indian ships gain passage, limiting oil relief.
